bindings.sponsor_text: Introduced by the Minister for Climate, Energy and the Environment
bindings.what_it_does: Creates a project-specific approval process for a State-led strategic gas emergency reserve at Cahiracon, Co. Clare, intended as emergency backup if Ireland's normal gas supply is seriously disrupted.
bindings.case_for: The Government argued Ireland needs emergency gas storage to protect security of supply during the transition to renewable energy.
bindings.concerns: Deputies questioned the bespoke planning route and sought stronger guarantees on emergency-only use, public control, climate safeguards and cost.
